items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you could hear him on the radio, but I had the extra pleasure of hearing him practicing, because he had relatives living in these domiciles.

ctx.x: A rooming house? Because he was from Ohio too, I think, Art Tatum. Toledo, was it? Or one of those towns?

I don’t know exactly what it was, but he used to come to Cincinnati a lot. Because he was on WLW in Cincinnati – WLW radio – you could hear him on the radio, but I had the extra pleasure of hearing him practicing, because he had relatives living in these domiciles.
Rooming house or whatever. What was that like, hearing him practice?
